turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Owen's essay. Why was there a zero before anyone called me?
Okay. Setting the grade aside for a second.
Not for a second. Who decided on the zero, and when?
If you were me, what would you do here? Genuinely.
Is Hale asking me how to do Hale's job? Who decided on the zero?
